title: A Measure-Valued Obstacle Problem for an Obliquely Reflected Diffusion with a Max-Type Payoff
summary: We study an obliquely reflected optimal stopping problem in the nonnegative quadrant with nonsmooth max-type payoff \(G(x)=x_1\veeαx_2\), and we develop a measure-valued potential-theoretic formulation of the associated obstacle problem. The kink of \(G\) on the diagonal \(x_1=αx_2\) produces a singular surface measure in the distributional generator, while the oblique reflection directions generate boundary local-time contributions on the coordinate faces.
